filters.description: Filter criteria. Every present key must match (filters_type 'and') or any present key may match ('or'). name, color, ids, layer, type, hidden and locked are built in; any other key is a custom user-string attribute, so those names cannot be used as attribute keys.

ids.description: Match objects with these ids. An id that is not in the document is refused with not_found.

layer.description: Match objects on this layer, by full layer path (for example 'Furniture::Chairs'). An unknown layer is refused with not_found.

type.description: Match objects of this normalized type, or of any type in the list (POINT, LINE, CURVE, BREP, EXTRUSION, ...).

hidden.description: true lets hidden objects (and objects on hidden layers) into the candidates and matches them; false matches visible objects. Omitted: hidden objects are not considered.

locked.description: true lets locked objects (and objects on locked layers) into the candidates and matches them; false matches unlocked objects. Omitted: locked objects are not considered.
